verifiedFacts.claim: Rolling Stone notes that "Ventilator Blues" is the only Exile track co-written by Mick Taylor, and that its title came from the single fan in a corner window of the Nellcôte basement that, as Andy Johns notes, "didn't work very well."

sourceRefs.label: Rolling Stone Exile on Main St. Track By Track article
sourceRefs.title: 'Exile on Main St.' Track By Track - Rolling Stone
sourceRefs.sourceIdentity: rollingstone.com|Exile on Main St. Track By Track 2006
sourceRefs.extract: The only track co-written by Mick Taylor, who felt he deserved more songwriting credit than Jagger and Richards were willing to give. There was just a single fan in a corner window of the Nellcôte basement, which, as Johns notes, “didn’t work very well. Therefore, ‘Ventilator Blues.’ It’s one of my favorite tunes. It’s about the fan in the window.”
